title: The White Bear
text: A great white bear sits in the snow, watching, its breath steaming. It has not eaten in a long time: its ribs show through its fur. It knows who is weakest. It has been watching them all morning.

options.label: Put the weakest in the middle, and give the bear no easy prey.

outcomes.text: The bear follows all day, but it does not attack the circle.

options.label: Feed the starving bear, so it has no reason to take one of yours.

outcomes.text: It eats, and walks away, and does not look back.

options.label: The Leader hunts it, before it chooses its moment.

outcomes.text: It has been waiting for that.
